enchantments.tooltip: Pirate Cleverness: You gain the cleverness of a pirate, which grants a +50 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all other bonuses except itself.
Enchantment Focus I: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Necromancy Focus I: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Efficient Metamagic - Maximize I: The additional spell point cost for using the Maximize Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
